obernants.operator: For validated input, output length differs from n or contains nonfinite components is excluded. The real DFT equation identifies an ideal target, but equality to it is not asserted for rounded f64 outputs; negative-phase and inverse normalization are required by the actual butterfly program.

obernants.operator: Ideal fixed-size DFT is invertible via inverse DFT. Rounded program fibers retain all finite bounded input bit patterns yielding the observed output; rounding may merge distinct inputs. Error InvalidValue admits any length-valid vector containing NaN, infinity or a component above1e100.

obernants.operator: Bit reversal is an involution; butterflies combine blocks of length2,4,...n. Every index is written once per stage, so n log2 n/2 butterflies execute.
